Want to learn English with easy lessons? You need our 12-chapter Learn English – Word Power 101 e-book. This is great for Beginners as a first step to learning English. You’ll start reading, speaking and understanding English. How? Keep reading.

- Learn with 12 Chapters of Easy English Lessons
- Includes Bonus Access to the EnglishClass101 Learning Program
- Includes Bonus Access to our English Learning App: Innovative Language 101

You learn the top 101 most-used English words and phrases that every Beginner must know. Each chapter covers easy categories like “Basic Expressions” “Questions” “Adjectives” and “Numbers.” You learn the word or phrase first. Then you learn how to use it in a sentence and gain a better understanding. You also master pronunciation with native audio examples.

With Learn English – Word Power 101, you get:

- 101 most-used English Words and Phrases
- Over 160 Pages of Lessons
- Native English Audio Examples for Every Entry
- Useful Example Sentences and Phrases
- Vibrant Images to Help with Memorization

Download Learn English – Word Power 101 right now and start learning English the easy way. You will learn 101 of the English words and phrases that every beginner must know.
